#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077

SOURCE_PARENT=/srv/inventory
SOURCE_NAME=data
DEST_HOST=10.100.188.10
DEST_USER=inventory-backup
DEST_DIR=/var/backups/inventory
KEY=/etc/inventory-backup/id_ed25519
KNOWN_HOSTS=/etc/inventory-backup/known_hosts
STAMP=\$(date +%F)
LOCAL_TMP=\$(mktemp \"/var/tmp/inventory-\${STAMP}.XXXXXX.tar.gz\")
REMOTE_TMP=\"\${DEST_DIR}/.inventory-\${STAMP}.tar.gz.part\"
REMOTE_FINAL=\"\${DEST_DIR}/inventory-\${STAMP}.tar.gz\"

cleanup() {
    rm -f \"\$LOCAL_TMP\"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

[ -d \"\${SOURCE_PARENT}/\${SOURCE_NAME}\" ]
tar -C \"\$SOURCE_PARENT\" -czf \"\$LOCAL_TMP\" \"\$SOURCE_NAME\"
rsync -a --chmod=F0600 \
    -e \"ssh -i \$KEY -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=\$KNOWN_HOSTS\" \
    \"\$LOCAL_TMP\" \"\${DEST_USER}@\${DEST_HOST}:\${REMOTE_TMP}\"
ssh -i \"\$KEY\" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile=\"\$KNOWN_HOSTS\" \"\${DEST_USER}@\${DEST_HOST}\" \
    \"set -eu; mv '\$REMOTE_TMP' '\$REMOTE_FINAL'; find '\$DEST_DIR' -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-????-??-??.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete\"
printf 'inventory backup completed: %s\n' \"\$REMOTE_FINAL\"
INVENTORY_BACKUP_SCRIPT

set -eu
umask 077

SOURCE_PARENT=/srv/inventory
SOURCE_NAME=data
DEST_HOST=10.100.188.10
DEST_USER=inventory-backup
DEST_DIR=/var/backups/inventory
KEY=/etc/inventory-backup/id_ed25519
KNOWN_HOSTS=/etc/inventory-backup/known_hosts
STAMP=\$(date +%F)
LOCAL_TMP=\$(mktemp \"/var/tmp/inventory-\${STAMP}.XXXXXX.tar.gz\")
REMOTE_TMP=\"\${DEST_DIR}/.inventory-\${STAMP}.tar.gz.part\"
REMOTE_FINAL=\"\${DEST_DIR}/inventory-\${STAMP}.tar.gz\"

cleanup() {
    rm -f \"\$LOCAL_TMP\"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

[ -d \"\${SOURCE_PARENT}/\${SOURCE_NAME}\" ]
tar -C \"\$SOURCE_PARENT\" -czf \"\$LOCAL_TMP\" \"\$SOURCE_NAME\"
rsync -a --chmod=F0600 \
    -e \"ssh -i \$KEY -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=\$KNOWN_HOSTS\" \
    \"\$LOCAL_TMP\" \"\${DEST_USER}@\${DEST_HOST}:\${REMOTE_TMP}\"
ssh -i \"\$KEY\" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile=\"\$KNOWN_HOSTS\" \"\${DEST_USER}@\${DEST_HOST}\" \
    \"set -eu; mv '\$REMOTE_TMP' '\$REMOTE_FINAL'; find '\$DEST_DIR' -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-????-??-??.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete\"
printf 'inventory backup completed: %s\n' \"\$REMOTE_FINAL\"
INVENTORY_BACKUP_SCRIPT
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
cat > /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup <<'INVENTORY_BACKUP_CRON'
SHELL=/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

17 2 * * * root /usr/bin/flock -n /run/inventory-backup.lock /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup >> /var/log/inventory-backup.log 2>&1
INVENTORY_BACKUP_CRON
chmod 0644 /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup
chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup
: > /var/log/inventory-backup.log
chmod 0600 /var/log/inventory-backup.log"
printf '%s\n' '--- script syntax ---'
sudo -n sh -n /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
printf '%s\n' '--- cron file ---'
sudo -n cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup
printf 'cron_active='; systemctl is-active cron
printf 'script='; sudo -n stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
printf 'log='; sudo -n stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /var/log/inventory-backup.log
